tagline: Your coding agent's hands and eyes in Chrome
brief: A Chrome extension that lets a coding agent (Claude Code, Codex) read any web page and act on it. It has no AI of its own: the agent is the mind. Named after Ichiro Kato, whose WABOT-1 (1973) had hands that gripped and eyes that measured distance.
criteria: Success: reads at 16 px in the Chrome toolbar, works in one colour, stays clear of sparkles, robot heads and cursor arrows, and fits the side panel's calm off-white and one blue.

concepts.name: Two eyes in the name
concepts.idea: The dots on the two i's in the name are eyes, like WABOT-1's two cameras.
rationale: The idea comes from the name itself, so nobody else can own it
Eyes say what Ichiro does (it looks at pages) without a robot head or a sparkle
One blue, only in the pupils: the panel's calm black-and-blue system
On dark backgrounds the eyes are redrawn, so the whites stay white

recommendation: Use the wordmark as the main logo, the blue tile for every icon, and the plain symbol for one-colour print.
next_steps: Swap the extension's toolbar icons for icons/icon-16 … icon-128
Put the wordmark in the side panel header
Run a trademark search before going public
